      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>
    <script>
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        const counter = document.querySelector('[data-el="counter"]');
        const eventTimestampDifference = 429306000;

        if (!counter || !eventTimestampDifference) return;

        startCountdown(eventTimestampDifference, counter);
      }, true);

      function startCountdown(eventTimestampDifference, node) {
        if (!node || isNaN(eventTimestampDifference)) return;

        const updateCountdown = () => {
          node.innerHTML = formatCountdown(eventTimestampDifference);

          if (eventTimestampDifference <= 0) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }
        };

        updateCountdown(); // Initial render
        const interval = setInterval(updateCountdown, 60 * 1000); // Every minute
      }

      function formatCountdown(ms) {
        const days = String(Math.floor(ms / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24))).padStart(2, '0');
        const hours = String(Math.floor((ms / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24)).padStart(2, '0');
        const minutes = String(Math.floor((ms / (1000 * 60)) % 60)).padStart(2, '0');
        return `<b>${days}</b>d <b>${hours}</b>h <b>${minutes}</b>m`;
      }
    </script>

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

        }

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

        if (dataSourceType === 2 && remainingTimeString === null) {
          if (elCounter) {
            elCounter.innerHTML = '<span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-live mr-1.5"></span><b>Now Live</b>';
          }

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      const interval = setInterval(updateCounter, 60 * 1000); // Every minute

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

      if (!elCountdown) {
        console.error('Countdown element not found.');
        return;
      }

      let mainEventDate = "2026-05-23 11:00:00";

      try {

        if (isNaN(mainEventDate.getTime())) {

        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing main event date:', error);
        return;
      }

      let dataSourceType = "1";

      try {
        dataSourceType = parseInt(dataSourceType, 10);

        if (isNaN(dataSourceType)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid DataSourceType');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing DataSourceType:', error);
        return;
      }

      const meetingStatus = "upcoming";

      const elUpcomingDate = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="upcoming-date"]');

      if (!elUpcomingDate) {
        console.info('Upcoming date element not found.');
      }

      const elCounter = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="counter"]');

      // Set the upcoming date
      try {
        const [day, month, year] = mainEventDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {
          throw new Error('Invalid date format');
        }

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

        if (dataSourceType === 2 && remainingTimeString === null) {
          if (elCounter) {
            elCounter.innerHTML = '<span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-live mr-1.5"></span><b>Now Live</b>';
          }

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      const interval = setInterval(updateCounter, 60 * 1000); // Every minute
      updateCounter(interval); // Initial render
    }, true);

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {

        }

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

        if (dataSourceType === 2 && remainingTimeString === null) {
          if (elCounter) {
            elCounter.innerHTML = '<span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-live mr-1.5"></span><b>Now Live</b>';
          }

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      const interval = setInterval(updateCounter, 60 * 1000); // Every minute
      updateCounter(interval); // Initial render

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

      if (!elCountdown) {

        return;

      let mainEventDate = "2026-06-04 19:00:00";

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing main event date:', error);
        return;

        if (isNaN(dataSourceType)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid DataSourceType');
        }
      } catch (error) {

        return;

      const meetingStatus = "upcoming";

        console.info('Upcoming date element not found.');
      }

      const elCounter = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="counter"]');

      // Set the upcoming date
      try {
        const [day, month, year] = mainEventDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {
          throw new Error('Invalid date format');
        }

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

        if (dataSourceType === 2 && remainingTimeString === null) {
          if (elCounter) {
            elCounter.innerHTML = '<span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-live mr-1.5"></span><b>Now Live</b>';
          }

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      const interval = setInterval(updateCounter, 60 * 1000); // Every minute
      updateCounter(interval); // Initial render
    }, true);

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

      // Set the upcoming date
      try {
        const [day, month, year] = mainEventDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {
          throw new Error('Invalid date format');
        }

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

          if (elCounter) {

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>

      if (!elCountdown) {

        return;
      }

      let mainEventDate = "2026-06-10 18:00:00";

      try {

      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing main event date:', error);
        return;
      }

      let dataSourceType = "1";

        if (isNaN(dataSourceType)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid DataSourceType');
        }
      } catch (error) {

        return;
      }

      const meetingStatus = "upcoming";

      const elUpcomingDate = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="upcoming-date"]');

      if (!elUpcomingDate) {
        console.info('Upcoming date element not found.');
      }

      const elCounter = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="counter"]');

      // Set the upcoming date
      try {
        const [day, month, year] = mainEventDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {
          throw new Error('Invalid date format');
        }

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

        if (dataSourceType === 2 && remainingTimeString === null) {
          if (elCounter) {
            elCounter.innerHTML = '<span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-live mr-1.5"></span><b>Now Live</b>';
          }

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      const interval = setInterval(updateCounter, 60 * 1000); // Every minute
      updateCounter(interval); // Initial render
    }, true);

      <script>
    (() => {
      const timetable = document.querySelector('[data-el="timetable"]');

      if (!timetable) return;

      const meetingCity = timetable.getAttribute('data-meeting-city');
      const formSwitchTime = timetable.querySelector('[data-el="switch-time"]');
      const timeEntries = [...timetable.querySelectorAll('[data-el="time-entry"]')];

      // After page load, find local times
      timeEntries.forEach(timeEntry => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(timeEntry.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));

        // In JS timestamps are in milliseconds
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--date-local', `'${getLocalDate(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
        timeEntry.style.setProperty('--time-local', `'${getLocalTime(timestamp * 1000)}'`);
      });

      formSwitchTime.addEventListener('change', () => {
        const formData = new FormData(formSwitchTime);
        const timeType = formData.get('time');

        if (timeType === 'local') {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'local');
        } else {
          timetable.setAttribute('data-show-type', 'venue');
        }

        updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity);
      });
    })();

    function getLocalDate(timestamp) {
      const date = new Date(timestamp);
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        weekday: 'short',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      }).formatToParts(date);
      const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(parts.map(({ type, value }) => [type, value]));
      return `${dateParts.weekday}, ${dateParts.day} ${dateParts.month}`;
    }

    function getLocalTime(timestamp) {
      const timeFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
        hour12: false,
      });
      return timeFormatter.format(timestamp);
    }

    function updateDaysInNodes(timeEntries, timeType, meetingCity) {
      let previousDay = null;
      const dateOptions = {
        day: '2-digit',
      };

      if (timeType === 'venue') {
        dateOptions.timeZone = window.cityNameTo[meetingCity].timeZone;
      }

      timeEntries.forEach(node => {
        const timestamp = parseInt(node.getAttribute('data-timestamp'));
        const date = new Date(timestamp * 1000);

        const dayNumber = date.toLocaleString('en-US', dateOptions);

        if (dayNumber !== previousDay) {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'true'); // Day has changed, set data-day-first to 'true'
        } else {
          node.setAttribute('data-day-first', 'false');
        }

        previousDay = dayNumber;
      });
    }
  </script>
  <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const elCountdown = document.querySelector('[data-el="countdown"]');

      if (!elCountdown) {
        console.error('Countdown element not found.');
        return;
      }

      let mainEventDate = "2026-06-19 18:00:00";

      try {
        mainEventDate = new Date(mainEventDate);

        if (isNaN(mainEventDate.getTime())) {
          throw new Error('Invalid date format');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing main event date:', error);
        return;
      }

      let dataSourceType = "1";

      try {
        dataSourceType = parseInt(dataSourceType, 10);

        if (isNaN(dataSourceType)) {
          throw new Error('Invalid DataSourceType');
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error parsing DataSourceType:', error);
        return;
      }

      const meetingStatus = "upcoming";

      const elUpcomingDate = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="upcoming-date"]');

      if (!elUpcomingDate) {
        console.info('Upcoming date element not found.');
      }

      const elCounter = elCountdown.querySelector('[data-el="counter"]');

      // Set the upcoming date
      try {
        const [day, month, year] = mainEventDate.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          day: '2-digit',
          month: 'short',
          year: 'numeric'
        }).replace(',', '').split(' ');

        if (!day || !month || !year) {
          throw new Error('Invalid date format');
        }

        if (elUpcomingDate) {
          elUpcomingDate.textContent = `${day} ${month}. ${year}`;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error formatting the upcoming date:', error);
      }

      // Function to update the countdown
      function getRemainingTimeString(targetDate) {
        try {
          const now = new Date();
          const diffTimestamp = Math.max(targetDate - now, 0); // prevent negative

          if (diffTimestamp <= 0) {
            return null;
          }

          const days = Math.floor(diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          const hours = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
          const minutes = Math.floor((diffTimestamp / (1000 * 60)) % 60);

          const format = (v) => String(v).padStart(2, '0');

          return `${format(days)}d ${format(hours)}h ${format(minutes)}m`;
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Error calculating remaining time:', error);
          return null;
        }
      }

      function updateCounter(interval) {
        const remainingTimeString = getRemainingTimeString(mainEventDate);

        if (dataSourceType === 2 && remainingTimeString === null) {
          if (elCounter) {
            elCounter.innerHTML = '<span class="inline-block w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-red-live mr-1.5"></span><b>Now Live</b>';
          }

          if (interval) {
            clearInterval(interval);
          }

          return;
        }

        if (elCounter) {
          elCounter.textContent = remainingTimeString;
        }
      };

      const interval = setInterval(updateCounter, 60 * 1000); // Every minute
      updateCounter(interval); // Initial render
    }, true);
  </script>
